description: We are Springboks, a team dedicated to making a tangible impact. I am Tarun. My skills include communication, creativity, maths, physics, and intermediate Python coding. We aim to use real data to create a game to teach We'd like someone who is proficient in coding, a critical thinker, and everyone must be eager to learn.
summary: We have designed and made progress in creating a resource management game for children between the ages of 7 and 12 year old. It teaches children fundamentals of being an astronaut or an engineer. It is vital for children to gain an interest and foundational knowledge of engineering in an enjoyable way.
details:
• Player must survive 100 sols on Mars and build their colony on a set grid
    • Food produced by farms
    • Power produced by nuclear reactors and solar panels
    • Oxygen levels produced by oxygen scrubbers
    • Must minimise radiation exposure
  • Solar flares and dust storms can hit the colony and can damage buildings
  • Player must repair buildings in to-do list to ensure that the resources they produce don't decrease to 0
  • At the end of the 100 Sols, the player can choose to start over or quit
